what: Camera aperture loader — inside a body circle at the screen center (.3 of the short side), seven metal blades open and close, flipping photos one at a time in black and white. One rotation speeds up from 1.15s to .08s (1.15 − 1.07 × progress^3.2), and the blade edges blur in proportion to the opening speed. When done, the last frame opens wide over .7s, and 1.1s later the hole and body grow larger than the screen diagonal (1.5s expo.inOut) and the inside of the hole turns transparent, revealing the page behind

options.run: Time in seconds that speeds up as images are flipped, default 3.4 (original db)
options.hold: Seconds until the last page is lifted after it opens, default 1.1
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photos to flip through (img or an element wrapping img) — the last one is the section that opens at the end. If none, only the blade opens and closes
options.fx:open · fx:done: When the page behind starts to be revealed · fired from the element after the panel disappears — hang the hero entrance on fx:open

from.where: shared.js loader (original aperture shader: body min(w,h)×.3 · open .94 · rotation blades×.35+(1−open)×.95 · scale 1.1−.08×turn · initial brightness 1.35 · clear diagonal×1.25/×1.3 · rotation −1.4 · scale 1.6 · opacity .45×clear).

note: With reduced motion it doesn’t draw, fires fx:open and fx:done right away, and hides. Photos must be same-origin (or CORS-enabled) to be read as textures.
